SELECT
    [Id] AS db_instructionId,
    [Version] AS db_version,
    [AccountId] AS db_accountId,
    [Status] AS db_status,
    [LetterOfAuthorization] AS db_letterOfAuthorization,
    [HolderRelationshipToAccount] AS db_holderRelationship,
    [RailType] AS db_railType,
    [CustodialInstructionNumber] AS db_custodianInstructionNumber,
    [CreatedDate] AS db_createdDate,
    [UpdatedDate] AS db_updatedDate
FROM [dbo].[MoneyMovementInstruction]
WHERE [Id] = '{{instructionId}}'
